# Colophon {.unnumbered}

This book is written in Markdown and built with Quarto 1.10.19 and Typst. Every example in
`examples/` is compiled with Nim 2.2.12 on each change, and its output is compared against the
expected file kept in the repository.

The book text is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 and the code samples MIT. The details are on the copyright
page, which also lists the source and how to report errors.

If something is wrong, report it in the
[issues](https://github.com/nferdazel/nim-id/issues). This book is actively maintained: future revisions
incorporate what readers find.

Thank you for reading this far.
